items.text: Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury and limited/no Friday practice; Rams optimistic after MRI.
items.why: Schefter and Rapoport confirmed active; ETR had GTD/optimism; McVay called calf minor.
items.implication: Must-start WR1; reverse any backup plans for other Rams WRs/TEs.
items.opportunity: Full route/target share expected in favorable matchup; Adams already out elevates him further.

items.text: Breece Hall INACTIVE for Week 7 vs Dolphins after GTD/pessimistic lean; returned to limited practice but held out.
items.why: Schefter listed among inactives; ETR flagged GTD/pessimism; quad injury history.
items.implication: Braelon Allen locked-in lead back and strong start in good matchup.
items.opportunity: Full snap/carry/route share for Allen; handcuff elevation confirmed.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7 after being listed questionable earlier; high-ankle sprain context from prior reports.
items.why: ETR weekend summary lists him OUT; corroborated by multiple beat/insider reports of high-ankle sprain and official downgrade.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts; Zay Flowers remains strong WR1 volume play with Huntley.
items.opportunity: Increased target share and red-zone looks for Flowers and Ravens pass-catchers; Huntley streaming QB option.

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos in snap share (50%), rush share (41%), route participation (34%); Dobbins only 21% snaps. Roster in 100% of leagues.
items.why: Berry pre-season call validated by post-game usage data; clear lead backfield role.
items.implication: Immediate RB2/flex starter and must-add; Dobbins downgraded heavily.
items.opportunity: Dominant snap/rush/route share signals every-down role and high ceiling ROS.

items.text: Aaron Jones knee injury (suffered vs Colts) not considered significant; source describes as day-to-day.
items.implication: Likely plays next week or limited; Jordan Mason (just returned) ready as lead if needed.
items.opportunity: Mason elevated handcuff/starter contingency; Vikings RB committee watch.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turn on purposeful slide; would have been tilting if serious but not expected to miss time.
items.why: Levitan direct take quoting ETR watch list; purposeful slide context reduces concern.
items.implication: No downgrade; continue as elite RB1.
items.opportunity: Full workload expected next week; no beneficiary shift.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY Monday vs Cowboys after hamstring; returned to practice.
items.why: ETR summary; multiple sources including Garafolo notes on return timeline.
items.implication: RB1 restart vs soft Cowboys run D; monitor final active status for MNF.
items.opportunity: Bellcow carries/red-zone; Eagles offense boost without Hurts long-term.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT; thins Eagles WR corps significantly for MNF.
items.why: ETR weekend injury summary explicit OUT listing.
items.implication: Elevated roles for remaining Eagles pass-catchers (Goedert, others); Saquon even more central if active.
items.opportunity: Target/route share spike for Dallas Goedert and any active WRs; MNF smash potential for remaining pieces.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN and activated/expected after prior absence; Packers RB returns.
items.why: ETR IN list; Schefter activation notes.
items.implication: Lead back role resumes; monitor snap share post-layoff.
items.opportunity: Carries and goal-line work; handcuffs down.

items.text: Seahawks opening 21-day practice window for Jadarian Price (chest); eligible return Week 8. Charles Cross high-ankle sprain (1-2 weeks hope).
items.why: Rapoport and Schefter/Macdonald confirmation; help on way for backfield.
items.implication: Potential RB depth/committee addition Week 8+; monitor activation.
items.opportunity: If activated and roles expand, shares with existing backs; OL impact from Cross.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 (clear lead), Tank Dell only 6 in first game back since 2024; Noel 15 (left early turf toe).
items.why: Levitan post-game route counts; Dell limited return.
items.implication: Nico locked as alpha; Dell not immediate full threat; Noel injury watch.
items.opportunity: Collins dominant target/route share; Dell handcuff/monitor for expansion.

items.text: Seahawks, Broncos, Vikings, Packers mentioned as potential Jonathan Taylor trade suitors ahead of Nov 10 deadline; Jadarian Price status uncertain but eligible Week 8—Seahawks could use weapon beyond JSN.
items.why: Levitan reacting to Schefter trade deadline names video; ties to Price window.
items.implication: JT value spike if traded to contender; monitor Colts sell-off signals. Price stash if SEA path.
items.opportunity: Landing spot could unlock higher volume/role; current Indy committee risk.

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd game without Rashee Rice); high volume but has never topped 83 receiving yards in 37 career games—ceiling note.
items.why: Direct route data from Levitan; Rice out (hamstring).
items.implication: Volume WR3/flex with Rice out, but historical efficiency caps upside; monitor targets conversion.
items.opportunity: Near every-dropback routes + red-zone potential in Chiefs offense; other WRs (Royals etc.) secondary.
items.conflict: High routes but low historical ceiling may conflict with pure volume rankings.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain on severity; was also attempting purposeful slide.
items.why: Levitan specific conclusion on ETR injury watch; hamstring noted.
items.implication: Monitor practice; potential role reduction or miss; Tracy also hamstring.
items.opportunity: If out/limited, backup RBs (e.g. other Giants) elevate; check depth.
